title: Kooky Gooey Slovakian Potato Dumplings
description: A funky and kid-friendly Slovakian dish featuring mustard powder and double-fry technique, made with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a fun family dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, flour, mustard powder, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add eggs to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Double-fry the dumplings by first frying them at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot with a side of sour cream.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or chives, if desired.
